program_solutions:
(rule!
  (reduce (lambda (out obj)
    (if (not (= (obj-color obj) 2)) out
      (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
             (rs (map fst cells))
             (cs (map snd cells)))
        (if (or (not (= (length cells) 3)) (= (min-list rs) (max-list rs)) (= (min-list cs) (max-list cs)))
          out
          (let ((elbow (find-first (lambda (p)
            (= (count-where (lambda (q)
                 (= (+ (abs (- (fst p) (fst q))) (abs (- (snd p) (snd q)))) 1))
               cells) 2)) cells)))
            (if elbow (set-cell out (fst elbow) (snd elbow) 4) out))))))
    g (objects g 0)))
